_audit_note.tests_behavior: second no-dominant: does the engine preserve a genuinely distributed, multi-centred chart without fabricating a single dominant spine from the Aquarius public cluster, the Saturn-in-1/MC route, or Jupiter domicile 11? This is a Q3 guard fixture, not a domain-heavy chart.
_audit_note.main_risk: the engine invents a false sole owner out of Mercury/Venus Aquarius 10, Saturn Cancer 1, or Jupiter Pisces 11 and compresses the chart into one axis instead of holding several real centres close together
_audit_note.expected_failure_if_bad: engine reads a single public-intellectual spine or a single insecurity/protection spine, while backgrounding the other real centres that make the chart genuinely distributed

defining_signatures.what: Public-conceptual expression that matters, but is not the whole chart: Sun Aquarius 9 with Mercury and Venus Aquarius 10
defining_signatures.why: the chart clearly has an idea-bearing, public-facing and expressive dimension. It wants to think outwardly, frame things conceptually and be seen through a certain kind of voice or social position. But this is one center among others, not the uncontested owner.

defining_signatures.what: An exposed protective self meeting disciplined function: Cancer Ascendant with Saturn Cancer 1 in detriment and Mars Capricorn 6 in exaltation
defining_signatures.why: the personality field is not cleanly armored. It is sensitive and defended at once, and it compensates through competence, function and disciplined action. This is a real center of the chart, but again not its only one.

defining_signatures.what: A softer collective and relational field: Jupiter Pisces 11 in domicile with Moon Leo 3 personalizing expression
defining_signatures.why: there is also a sincere social and affiliative dimension that neither collapses into pure detachment nor into pure defensiveness. It gives the chart a more human, connective and idealistic center that must stay visible if the reading is to remain truthful.

between: an impersonal/public conceptual and social-expression line
a much more exposed, defended and compensating personal shell
a real need for warmth, recognition and human response

must_not_lead_with.claim: Mercury Aquarius 10 as the only defining spine
must_not_lead_with.reason: the chart does have a public-intellectual center, but this fixture exists to guard against compressing a genuinely distributed chart into one owner

must_not_lead_with.claim: Saturn Cancer 1 as the whole identity
must_not_lead_with.reason: the defended self is real, but it must not erase the public-conceptual and affiliative centres that are also structurally present

must_not_lead_with.claim: Jupiter Pisces 11 as a spiritual-savior whole identity
must_not_lead_with.reason: the chart has a soft collective center, but it is one center among several and should not become the sole narrative either
this is the second explicit no-dominant guard fixture; the chart should remain distributed in the gold

one_line_person: A genuinely distributed chart: public-conceptual expression, exposed self-protection, functional discipline and affiliative warmth all matter, and the reading becomes false the moment one of them is promoted into the whole identity.
